name: graph-network
description: An advanced graph network library. Supports directed/undirected representations, shortest path solvers using Dijkstra and A* search, Minimum Spanning Trees (MST) via Kruskal's algorithm (using inline Disjoint Set Union), and Tarjan's Strongly Connected Components (SCC) algorithm.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need pathfinding (Dijkstra, A*), spanning tree layouts (Kruskal), or cycle and strongly connected component detections (Tarjan) in directed/undirected graphs.
